Davies we don't want to merge Sparkr-SQL into master long term as SparkRSQL needs Spark 1.3. So the plan is that we will keep master compatible with Spark 1.2 and we will rename sparkr-sql as branch-1.3

However, we still need to merge a bunch of stuff from master to sparkr-sql and also some non-DF changes from sparkr-sql to master. Will try to do this ASAP
